name: What are common reasons a gate needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons a gate needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gates often require repair due to damage from vehicles, wear and tear on hinges and latches, issues with automatic openers, or weather-related problems. Regular use can loosen components, while accidents can bend frames or break panels. Electrical issues can also affect automatic gate functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common gate repair reasons include vehicle damage, worn hardware, automatic opener malfunctions, and weather-related issues.
